name: Kokoro Toshokan Communication Library Visual Drama
original_name: ココロ図書館 コミュニケーションライブラリー ビジュアルドラマ
source: A short visual novel included as part of the "Kokoro Library Communication Library" library cataloging software. Chapters are unlocked as books are entered into the library software; approximately 120 books are required to unlock the entire story.
